experiences.situation: Default uv environment excludes torch so make check can run without a CUDA wheel.
experiences.problem: test_run_progress_bar imported LightningTrainingRun before the ImportError skip, so pytest collection failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named torch.
experiences.successful_approach: Moved the lightning.run import inside the existing try/except ImportError guard, matching sibling lightning tests.
experiences.evidence: make check exited 0. pytest --cov reported 365 passed and 9 skipped.
experiences.reusable_lesson: When torch is an optional extra, keep torch imports inside the module-level skip guard. A skip after a top-level import never runs.
experiences.avoid: Importing torch-backed modules at test module top level before pytest.skip.
experiences.applicability: Pytest modules that must collect in an environment without torch.

experiences.situation: Pre-commit mypy failed on Lightning tests that treat configure_optimizers as a dict.
experiences.problem: Lightning types configure_optimizers as a wide OptimizerLRScheduler union, so string-key access and the in operator are rejected.
experiences.successful_approach: Annotate the module with OptimizerLRSchedulerConfig and type build_scheduler as LRSchedulerConfigType, which is the mapping the code already returns.
experiences.evidence: uv run mypy reported Success on five source files; CUDA-venv pytest passed six tests; ruff and xenon were clean.
experiences.reusable_lesson: When Lightning exposes a union, type the actual returned TypedDict at the producer instead of adding type ignore in tests.
experiences.avoid: Silencing the union with type ignore or indexing OptimizerLRScheduler as if every variant were a dict.
experiences.applicability: Python Lightning modules whose configure_optimizers always returns optimizer and lr_scheduler keys.
